atoms.text:
Lila likes lying in bed and pretending to be different things.

Sometimes she imagines she is a great big whale and her bed is the ocean. Her sheets are the waves. She swims through them until they fall on the floor and the ocean is calm once more.

Sometimes Lila pretends to be an artist. She turns her pillows and blankets into towers and sculptures. She has shows for her stuffed animals.

Sometimes she is a caterpillar. She rolls herself in her blanket and wiggles around trying to grow wings.

Sometimes Lila pretends to be asleep. Then tomorrow comes and she realises she wasn’t pretending at all.
